card.name: Dosing and storage instruction wording
card.fires_on: Words inside dosing and storage instructions, such as 'next dose', 'twice daily', 'room temperature' and 'after each dialysis'. It also fires on pieces of long words such as dial-ysis and acet-amin-ophen.

modes.label: Dose timing phrases
modes.description: The word dose or daily ends a phrase about when to take or repeat a dose.
modes.example: If a dose is missed, take the next<< dose>> at the usual time.

modes.label: Storage wording
modes.description: Words in room-temperature storage statements for an unopened product.
